required_observables: stderr including diagnostic message, hints and rendered span

unknown_policy.Preserved: every required public observable is complete and equals the pinned oracle
unknown_policy.Violated: at least one complete public observable contradicts the pinned oracle and includes a witness
unknown_policy.Unknown: timeout, missing product, ambiguous identity, unsupported parser construction or incomplete observation
unknown_policy.rule: Unknown never counts as success except for an explicitly opaque calibration case whose expected result is Unknown.

calibration_budget.stop_rule: Two consecutive revisions without discriminatory gain for the same cause stop as P1300_BLOCKED_CONTRACT_DESIGN.

P1_contract_author.context: fresh agent context without candidate patch

P2_oracle_author.context: fresh agent context after contract hash is frozen

P3_adversary.context: fresh agent context after contract hash is frozen

P4_discrimination_sealer.context: fresh agent context after oracle and adversarial artifacts are frozen

P5_AB_tester.context: fresh agent context started before implementation candidate exists

P6_implementer.context: fresh agent context started independently from P5

all frozen inputs and integrated candidate

index_policy: No staging, commit or push. Existing index must remain unchanged.
invalidation_rule: Any change to confirmed L0, baseline, manifest, contract, oracle or seal after its freeze invalidates downstream artifacts and restarts from the first affected phase.
